comparison.objective: Fasten an instrument case using separate spring hooks and safety catches.
comparison.physical_skill: Hook selection, lever tensioning, and independent secondary-latch engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Case remains fastened hands-free for 20 seconds with cases and instruments upright; detailed tiers are absent.
comparison.reason: Latch fastening and dwell retention differ from preserving a calibrated screw position under jam-nut countertorque and then cycling the mechanism.
